name: a captured merchant
text: A bound merchant sits among them.

name: a captured pilgrim
text: A pilgrim is tied to a tree behind them.

name: a captured scholar
text: A scholar in torn robes is held at spear-point.

name: a captured grave-digger
text: A grave-digger is bound and gagged in the corner.

name: a chained beastman deserter
text: A chained beastman deserter is with them.

name: an old-breed goblin
text: An old-breed goblin is bound between them.

name: the warlord's flesh crafter
text: A flesh crafter in chains works among them.

name: a mourner taken with her dead
text: An old orc woman, who followed her husband's body here, is tied to a pillar among them.

name: a grey-robed Priest of Death
text: A Priest of Death in torn grey robes kneels in chains. The Faithful need her for the rite.

name: a thrall kept for feeding
text: A gnome woodcutter, bitten and bled white, is chained to a bed among them.
